Body.Content:
Streamline your Azure admin experience with Azure Cloud Shell, a browser-based shell experience running in the cloud to help manage your Azure resources.

Use Cloud Shell to:

  • Get the power and flexibility of using a modern command-line experience.
  • Use a shell maintained and updated by Microsoft.
  • Access commonly used CLI tools, including Linux shell interpreters, Azure tools, text editors, source control, build tools, container tools, database tools, and more.
  • Access and run your favorite scripts from attached Azure File storage.
  • Switch to a PowerShell experience (currently in preview).

Learn more about Azure Cloud Shell.
